name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Wulfric's levy is between Cedric and Beatrix.

Between Aldric and Weaver, one goes with 7 coins and the other with 8 coins.
The Carpenter's levy is lower than both Aldric and the Weaver.
